title: UFO shines light at Chernobyl reactor

as_told.title: Similar UFO radiation episode at Chernobyl written up by Jensen Andre

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a writer with a Harvard doctorate, whom he calls Jensen Andreon, writes about a UFO seen at the height of the Chernobyl disaster in 1986, when a nuclear plant in Soviet Ukraine blew up. According to that account, many people nearby saw the object arrive, stay about three minutes, shine a light at the reactor and leave. Michels tells it as part of a pattern of UFOs said to watch over nuclear sites, and in a later episode he mentions the Chernobyl accounts again only in passing.
